case_name: Add a logo or text overlay
title: Subtle Handle Watermark Throughout
tests: Tests exact handle rendering as a persistent, readable, translucent watermark without changing the source footage or audio.

faults.what: The watermark is positioned at the bottom center, not the requested bottom right.
The text is large and appears opaque rather than small and visibly translucent. A prominent dark rectangular backing obscures the footage instead of providing only a faint shadow.

judge.summary: The correct handle is consistently readable, but it appears as a large bottom-center label with a dark box rather than a subtle bottom-right watermark.

must_haves.item: The watermark reads exactly '@flightschool' and stays visible throughout the entire clip.
must_haves.why: The handle is spelled correctly and visible in all four supplied output frames spanning the clip.

must_haves.item: The handle remains fixed at the bottom right with clear space between the text and both frame edges.
must_haves.why: It remains fixed with ample edge clearance, but it is horizontally centered rather than at the bottom right.

must_haves.item: The text is small, white, visibly translucent, and readable against the changing footage, with a subtle shadow.
must_haves.why: It is white and readable, but oversized and apparently opaque, with a conspicuous dark rectangular backing rather than a subtle shadow.

must_haves.item: The original cockpit footage remains unchanged apart from the watermark, with no extra card or scene.
must_haves.why: The later output frames closely resemble the supplied source frame and no extra card is shown, but a single source frame cannot establish that all footage and existing subtitles remain unchanged.

must_haves.item: The output lasts 7 seconds and preserves the original synchronized audio.
must_haves.why: The supplied metadata confirms a seven-second output with speech, but no original audio or playback is available to verify preservation and synchronization.
